text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. The goal is 
the ultimate race at the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Symboli Rudolf's participation was 
confirmed, it could be achieved. And it 
surely would be. An Umamusume, Mejiro 
Ramonu mused, cannot resist her true 
calling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to win the Queen Elizabeth 
II Cup so I can head into the Japan Cup in 
peak condition. Let's hone our skills 
during this summer training camp.
